base.description: Factual, computational, and interpretive correctness; uncertainty and unknowns are preserved.
Uses enough appropriate evidence, preserves provenance, and does not upgrade weak proxies into proof.
Performs the material method/invariants needed for the job. Equivalent or improved implementation is acceptable; skipping essential work is not.
Covers the material work implied by the requested outcome, business context, and relevant Workflow knowledge without filler or exhaustive work for its own sake.
A competent professional could use the result without rebuilding the core work from scratch.
The work is tied to the actual business objective rather than vanity activity or benchmark-shaped output.
The work includes the reasonable research, strategy, execution, QA, and integration that a strong practitioner could perform now to maximize the intended result.

Persisted AURA state truthfully preserves material organizational meaning, provenance, decisions/results/outcomes/unresolved work as appropriate, without inventing facts or manufacturing ceremony solely for qualification.
